what: A single line of text flows endlessly across the strip (one loop per 60 seconds) and stops when off screen. By default it pauses on hover (pause: none keeps it running). If there is a close button, the × rotates 90° on hover and pressing it slides the strip up and away in .4s

options.speed: Seconds per loop, default 60 (brand footer band 45)
options.gap: Gap between the two sets (px), default 0 (brand footer band 100)
options.pause: If none, it does not pause when the pointer is over it (default pauses)
options.[data-fx-part=close]: Close button (child) — click fires the fx:close event
options.dir: If right, it flows to the right (default left) — Brand photo strip
options.rate: Pixels flowing per second — if set, length is measured as half width ÷ rate instead of speed (Hotel site News strip 30)
options.axis: y makes it flow upward as a vertical column (dir: down flows downward) — the band needs a height. The About-section photo column of Brand
options.boost: Scroll speed (px/s) divided by this value speeds up in .2s, then eases to normal in 1.4s power2.out — 0 (default) means unused. gsap is required (Brand 350)
options.max: Upper limit of the multiplier added by boost, default 6
options.slow: On hover it slows by this multiplier instead of stopping (1 when released) — Brand logo strip .25
options.brake: On hover it doesn’t stop abruptly but glides to a stop with this ms time constant (also when focus enters), and on release it regains its normal speed with the same time constant — Brand number strip 180
options.jitter: Two vertical offset range numbers per cell (px, ‹min max›). When given, each cell drops to a random height in between and is not clipped vertically (source photo strip -30 120 · phone -10 60, rate 100 · phone 70)
options.back: Seconds to return to its own speed after boost, default 1.4 — Brand 1.2
options.rate-narrow: Pixels per second to use at 979px and below — given along with rate (Brand notice·footer band 42 → 35)
options.delay: Pause before flowing (seconds), default 0 — it stays in the first position meanwhile (Brand cover strip .5)
